comments.body: Hey @pcbeingused333, thank you for your PR and for catching this. You are right about the precedence issue. However, as far as I can see, nothing calls this function anymore since the orchestrator and the step operator moved to `kube_utils.create_job`, so I opened https://github.com/zenml-io/zenml/pull/5436 to remove it instead. I will close this one in favour of that. Thanks again 👍
